scope: By immunoprecipitating TAF-containing complexes from different cellular compartments, we identify a novel endogenous TFIID subcomplex formed by TAF2, 8 and 10 in the cytoplasm of human cells.
To identify proteins that co-precipitated with TAF2 we subjected the immunoprecipitated samples to proteomics analysis by using the multidimensional protein identification technology (MudPIT).

Immunoprecipitated proteins were eluted from the protein G columns with 0.1 M glycine (pH 2.5) and quickly neutralized with 2 M Tris-HCl (pH 8.8). For MudPIT analyses, protein mixtures were trichloroacetic acid precipitated, urea denaturated, reduced, alkylated and digested with endoproteinase Lys-C followed by modified trypsin digestion.
